summary: Test only: test-voice-waiting-cues.cjs no longer sleeps a fixed 20 ms before reading the run status; it waits (5 s bound) for the persisted effect of each observer frame, and an ordered barrier step proves the discovery and result frames were applied before asserting they did not move the activity.
reason: Intermittent local CI failure at the first activity assertion (about line 73): the observer persists each frame through its own write queue and registry write, which a loaded host does not finish within 20 ms. 15/15 idle runs passed, one loaded CI run failed; the product code was not at fault.
